timezone_note: cron in .github/workflows/short.yml is UTC; 17:00 UTC = 18:00 Casablanca (winter) / 19:00 (summer).
notes: One episode per run. The rotation alternates series so the channel is not one long story.
Episodes are authored in channel/series/*.json. Add an episode object and it joins the queue.
Nothing is published without a human approval on the 'youtube-approval' environment.
